item.title: Clearer saved workout routines
item.summary: Review your routine directly in chat, with a clear distinction between a proposed plan and a saved routine.
item.details: When you ask to save a routine, Murph checks the saved exercises and sets before confirming. Missing or unreadable routines get an explanation in chat instead of a link to the unfinished Training preview.

tryIt.label: Review my routine
tryIt.prompt: Show my saved workout routine here in chat.
